messages.content: 想像一下你是一位房地產投資者。你5年前以50萬美元買下了一個物業。該物業的年折舊率為2%。你能計算出該物業目前的折舊值嗎？現在，假設你在同一時間有20萬美元的資金。如果過去5年的年通貨膨脹率為3%，那麼這筆資金今天的價值是多少？另外，假設你借了30萬美元，年利率為4%，用於購買該物業。如果貸款期限為10年，你每月的還款金額是多少？最後，如果你每月計算物業的折舊，而不是每年，那麼該物業的折舊值是多少？

function.name: finance_loan_repayment

function.description: Adjusts a sum of money for inflation based on the consumer price index (CPI). Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_sum.description: The initial sum of money. This is a float type value.

years.description: The number of years over which inflation is calculated.

inflation_rate.description: The annual rate of inflation. This is a float type value.

function.name: finance_property_depreciation
function.description: Calculates the depreciated value of a property given its initial cost, depreciation rate, and the number of years. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_cost.description: The initial cost of the property. This is a float type value.

depreciation_rate.description: The annual depreciation rate in percentage. This is a float type value.

years.description: The number of years for which to calculate the depreciation.

monthly.description: If set to true, it will calculate monthly depreciation instead of annually. (optional)

2. Inflation adjustment: initial sum 200,000, years 5, inflation rate 3%. Value today = 200,000 * (1 + 0.03)^5.

3. Loan repayment: loan amount 300,000, interest rate 4% annual, term 10 years. Monthly repayment: use formula: M = P * r_monthly / (1 - (1 + r_monthly)^-n). r_monthly = 0.04/12. n = 10*12 = 120.

4. Monthly depreciation: property depreciation monthly instead of annually. So depreciation rate per month = 2% annual / 12? Actually if annual depreciation rate 2%, monthly depreciation rate = 0.02/12 = 0.0016667. After 5 years (60 months), depreciated value = 500,000 * (1 - 0.0016667)^60.

Inflation: (1+0.03)^5 = 1.03^5. 1.03^2=1.0609; ^3=1.092727; ^4=1.125508; ^5=1.159274. So 200,000 * 1.159274 = 231,854.8.

Loan repayment: r_monthly = 0.04/12 = 0.0033333333. n=120. Compute denominator: 1 - (1+r)^-n. (1+0.0033333)^-120. First compute (1+0.0033333)^120. Use ln: ln(1.0033333)=0.0033278. times 120 = 0.399336. exp = e^0.399336 = 1.490. So (1+r)^-n = 1/1.490 = 0.671. Denominator = 1 - 0.671 = 0.329. So monthly payment ~ $3,039.5.

Alternatively we can compute using formula: M = P * r / (1 - (1+r)^-n). r=0.0033333. So M = 300,000 * 0.0033333 / (1 - (1.0033333)^-120). We computed denominator 0.329. So M ~ 3,039.5.

Monthly depreciation: monthly rate = 0.02/12 = 0.0016666667. After 60 months: (1 - 0.0016667)^60. Compute ln: ln(1-0.0016667) ≈ -0.001668. times 60 = -0.10008. exp = e^-0.10008 = 0.9049.
